✓ Chera dynasty.fact: The Cheras, known as one of the mu-ventar (the Three Crowned Kings) of Tamilakam (the Tamil country) alongside the Cholas and Pandyas, have been documented as early as the third century BCE. Chera influence extended over central Kerala and western Tamil Nadu until the end of the early historic period in southern India.
